tweet_summary: A clearly-labeled parody Trump account jokes about a 'great deal' with Iran to jointly patrol the Strait of Hormuz, collect tolls, and sink non-paying vessels.
why_note_decision: The account's display name is 'President Trump Commetary' [sic] and its bio explicitly says 'This is PARODY' (along with absurd claims like 'won 62 states'). Replies recognize it as parody. The post is satire. Adding a note 'explaining' that this isn't a real deal undermines satire and is a classic CN false positive. Notably the underlying topic (Trump/Iran/Hormuz tolls 'joint venture') is real — Trump DID float a joint-venture idea in early April 2026 per Jonathan Karl/ABC, so the parody is a riff on actual news, which makes a corrective note even more confusing. Raters correctly tagged 'note not needed'.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The account is explicitly labeled PARODY in its bio and the tweet is a satirical riff on real (and contested) reporting about a Trump 'joint venture' floating with Iran over Hormuz tolls. FAIL if the bot writes ANY note — even one identifying the parody — that is the original note's mistake. FAIL especially if the bot 'corrects' the deal by saying no deal exists (the real news context makes this confusing).

original_unhelpful_note.text: The account is a parody, as stated in its bio. No US-Iran deal exists to jointly patrol the Strait of Hormuz or split toll profits; Iran has unilaterally imposed tolls on some ships. https://x.com/RealPresidentT https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-04-01/strait-of-hormuz-ships-paying-iran-yuan-and-crypto-tolls-for-safe-passage https://www.chron.com/news/world/article/iran-s-proposal-to-collect-tolls-in-the-strait-of-22196184.php
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Note not needed — clearly-labeled parody account; readers recognized it (see replies). Adding a note dignifies an obvious joke as a factual claim worth correcting.

fact_check.claim_verdict: labeled parody; not a sincere assertion
fact_check.notes: Real Trump did float a 'joint venture' idea on Hormuz tolls in April 2026, making the parody a topical riff. Bio says PARODY.

importance.lens_rationale: ~929K impressions but satirical/joke; no public-interest correction value.
